title: Shame, anger, fear and jealousy
learning_outcomes: Explain shame and guilt in the context of shame, anger, fear and jealousy.
Compare and distinguish anger fear and jealousy in the context of shame, anger, fear and jealousy.
Apply needs versus control in the context of shame, anger, fear and jealousy.
Evaluate and justify decisions about repair in the context of shame, anger, fear and jealousy.

lessons.title: Shame and guilt
lessons.outcome: Explain shame and guilt in the context of shame, anger, fear and jealousy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving shame and guilt; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to scenario response portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain shame and guilt from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of shame and guilt; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Anger fear and jealousy
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish anger fear and jealousy in the context of shame, anger, fear and jealousy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving anger fear and jealousy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to scenario response portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain anger fear and jealousy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of anger fear and jealousy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Needs versus control
lessons.outcome: Apply needs versus control in the context of shame, anger, fear and jealousy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving needs versus control; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to scenario response portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain needs versus control from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of needs versus control; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Repair
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about repair in the context of shame, anger, fear and jealousy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving repair; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to scenario response portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain repair from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of repair; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of shame and guilt; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of anger fear and jealousy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
